**Counting continuous numbers**

I’m looking at counting the numbers from 23 to 134, and I need to ensure that it includes every number without any skips. So, I realize that when I calculate the total, 134 minus 23, plus one, equals 112. That means there are 112 continuous numbers between 23 and 134 inclusive. Alright, now I feel confident that I’m checking that correctly!
